Complete replacement of both master and guest showers/tubs. Matthew Stemm checks every box in the arsenal with both knowledge and attention to detail that I thought were no longer available. In addition, when a grab bar was determined to be added in the bathtub, Priscilla was the contact person who made sure this happened. Matt Sr did the install, but she kept the project in the work plan. I’ve been Very impressed with Zintex. Not cheap, but definitely the best

David Withers was my installer.  He worked alone.  He dismantled the old tub/shower unit.  He then installed the new walk-in shower.  Hekept the workspace clean and well organized.  He gave me a quick demonstration as to how the shower controls worked.  When he was finished, the bathroom and hallway were spotless.  He was very polite and easy to talk with.  I would highly recommend him.

Very nice job - very courteous and knowledgeable contractor - excellent job - we will know more when we get to use it tomorrow 👍🏼👍🏼

Also to mention Ms. Cindy for making sure everything went as planned - great job 👌

Thank you Ms. Cindy
All was great.  Thomas got us what we wanted and Priscilla kept us informed until start date.  Could not be happier
I’m very satisfied with my new shower.

We liked the how the sales rep was absolutely “no pressure”  and he worked with us on a pice that we could afford! We were able to replace 2 showers. One was a shower bath that concerned us as our 88 year old dad uses that particular bathroom.  Concern relieved with a Zintex step-in shower!
We had an excellent experience on our install. Tom Grossman the consultant, Dawn the team leader and Brannon the installer were all  very knowledgeable and professional. Thanks for a great job.
Jennifer Sharp did a great job today. On time very and great customer service. Excellent at her job. Will be getting in touch with her
Professional  cleanliness  experienced  done on time

We worked with Aiden Sebert on getting started with our Bathroom remodel for my dad and he was very courteous and paid attention to every detail. I would definitely do business with him again and recommend this company!
Zintex always provides amazing customer service and in a timely fashion. I've been extremely happy with my shower remodel and any follow up servicing/support I've needed from them!

I recently had the pleasure of working with Zintex Remodeling Group for my tub/shower combo conversion to a walk-in shower, and I can’t say enough good things about my installer, Matthew! From start to finish, he did a phenomenal job.

Matthew was incredibly punctual and always arrived on time, which I truly appreciated. He took the time to explain every step of the process thoroughly, making sure I felt comfortable and informed throughout the project. His attention to detail was impressive, and he consistently kept me updated on the progress, which made the whole experience enjoyable.

Not only is Matthew extremely talented and knowledgeable in his craft, but he also has a wonderful demeanor that made working with him a delight. He cleaned up as he went along, leaving my space tidy at the end of each day. It’s clear that he takes great pride in his work!

I would highly recommend Matthew for any bathroom remodeling project. His remarkable skills and dedication to his craft truly set him apart. Thank you, Matthew, for transforming my bathroom into a beautiful space!

Best,
Michael Turner
Very professional. He took his time and did the job right. Willy is the plumber you want.

Sales person was detailed in explaining the process & had plenty of samples to choose from. Installers were on time, professional & efficient. They took pictures of everything they did & showed them to me prior to leaving.

Marco, Dominic, Emily and Nic did a phenomenal job! They left the bathroom spotless and were super friendly and informative from start to finish! They were very knowledgeable and professional, and provided us with exactly what we asked for! I highly recommend Zintex over any other company in the Memphis area!!
Consultant was very helpful and thorough in her presentation.
Carlos, Micellar, The contractors Eddie Rodriguez and his entire crew were fabulous! I have already recommended them to 3 people

David Elms did a wonderful job installing our new Jacuzzi shower grab bar. He explained things throughout the process and was very friendly. He cleaned up after himself very thoroughly. We couldn’t have asked for anyone better. Priscilla Garcia dis a wonderful job setting everything up.

Beautiful work.  Chelsea, Project Manager, was a pleasure to work with. Donte, our installer, was professional and efficient.  We had two bathrooms updated and both were finished in two days.  Job well done.  Thank you.
Marty was very thorough and professional. He was happy to answer all of our questions, made some terrific suggestions, and helped us understand our options. Very friendly and helpful.
Zintex was amazing to work with. Brandon did an amazing job on the installation. Tom and Matt were amazing to work with. 100% recommend!
Perfect I can say more

It was amazing. The help was so great making sure everything was moved and covered so nothing was messed up. They Worked like an orchestra.  So percercise.  After everything was spotless and  back in place. Manners were amazing.  Would recommend this company for anything you may want done. So impressed with sales people and workers.
Again thank you for everything it was so perfect.
Rigo Rosas did a good and quick job also asked if we were satisfied.

Vern Jackson and Mikel Hall did a great job. They worked very well together as a team and finished our project in a much shorter timeframe than anticipated. Sam Burwell stopped in to make sure everything was okay. Very happy with the Zintex team, including Rebecca, Kate, Marty, and Seth who did the first part of our installation.

I had a great installation experience! The install crew was really professional and knowledgeable about the product and the installation process. From the time they did an awesome job with containment by protecting my home with drop cloths and other supplies. I can tell this crew has been working together by their personable communication skills. The craftsmanship by the weekend install crew 7/10 was impeccable! There was an unforseen repair and the crew and Supervisor resolved without any conflicts. I would highly recommend this weekend install crew and Supervisor for a professional experience.
Samuel and his crew did a splendid job.  They were friendly and professional, and they got the entire job done in a single day.  I highly recommend these workers.
He was very knowledgeable and easy to understand even if you declined the financing for a senior citizen! A shower replacement was all I was looking for and a little overpriced for a simple job.

Christian was so meticulous with every detail of our shower install. I wouldn’t hesitate for a minute recommending him in the future. Our shower is beautiful and he made sure it was installed perfectly. Such a great job and a quality product.

Fantastic tub to shower remodel! Our installer, Fidel was awesome! He was careful, courteous, and very meticulous in his work. Kept the area organized and as tidy as a remodel can be in progress.
Our project manager Rebecca Ikenberg was on top of things and kept us informed of how the project was progressing. The whole team was great to work with. Including the salesman Jim Wilson who took time to walk us through the process and showed us progress photos.
I had a excellent installer very good. And Chelsea was excellent at keeping us up to date

We had our tub transformed into a walk in shower. It is so beautiful!! We are well pleased. Emily, the project mgr was very nice and was there anytime we had questions. The installers were polite and very respectful. Thank you Zintex!!
Cindy Odom was great in every aspect of helping me select my bathroom remodel. I am also pleased with the services of Rebecca and Dakota.
Good installers!

I called Monday morning to let customer service know that I had a mold issue that needed to be taken care of as soon as possible. This was the only issue I've had in the three years since they did the remodel.  They called me back that afternoon and had me scheduled for Wednesday morning the same week.  My tech Phillip called Tuesday afternoon to let me know he'd be there between 10-10:30 Wednesday morning and he would let me know when he was 10 minutes away.  He arrived on time, was professional and very personable.  I was very impressed with the outcome and reaction time to my issue.  I strongly recommend Zintec for your bathroom remodeling needs.  They truly stand behind their promises and products... fantastic customer service!!
Communication between Chelsea at Zintec and installer David was wonderful in getting exactly what we wanted with our shower remodel. High quality products and very fast to install. Took just 3 days.

I love my new walk in tub and shower! Tyson and Moses did a great job installing it and cleaning up afterwards. I would recommend these two men to anyone. They were very professional and easy to work with. They went above and beyond anything I expected.
Great job!! Very happy with him!!
Very professional.  Incredibly kind and informative. A joy to have
I was always provided up dates. Mike the installer was very professional and timely. Mike craftsmanship was outstanding.
Enjoyed our experience with Terry Anderson of Zintex. Very detailed in explaining so many things having to do with our project. Can't  wait!
Had my main  bath remodeled to a Jacuzzi bath by Zintex contractor Adrian Bryan. He was very professional and good to have this remodel done. We are very happy with his work.

Our time spent with Zintex was outstanding they professional and friendly.  It all started with Jon the sales rep. he gave us complete details of what to expect.  Jon took his time to help us understand all of those upgrade details.  We
were later contacted by Priscilla our contact at their office.  She did a great job keeping us informed of the planning stages and to just say hello.  Then there was Justin the installer.  He was very professional and friendly.  If we had questions along the way he answered them.  It was amazing the attention to detail these professionals took.  We are very impressed by the Zintex company.

ZINTEX installed a tub to shower this week with Jacuzzi material.. The quality of work was excellent and it has a lifetime warranty. ZINTEX I consider an excellent company. They stayed in contact throughout the process. Jonathan Landache did the install. His experience and skills are extraordinary he did a top notch job. Everything works perfectly and the safety features are second to none! I highly recommend ZINTEX! Jacuzzi has cornered the market on these shower installs!
Simply amazing..A job well done in a timely manner. The technicians were very nice guys. ZinTex is the way to go if you’re in need for bathroom renovation.
Christian, the instillation person appear to be very professional with a great demeanor and much appreciated throughout the whole process during offered services.  Thanks!
Good salesman. Respectful and understanding.
Great guys, professional in all aspects of the job. Made sure it was exactly what we wanted and expected
Brian and Brandon were polite and professional!! Cleaned up every day, finished on time. Beautiful job!

Byron was the salesman that helped me and he was great and so helpful. He put in a lot of time and energy. Cindy - thank you for keeping in touch with me through the process. And Daniel did a great job installing. I’m so happy with how my shower turned out.
Brad (?) was great! He stuck to his work and did a great install AND some helpful hints for maintenance. He also reminded us of the lifetime waranty.

The process to have our project assessed, contact with our project manager Rebecca, through demolition and installation by Vern and Mike was effortless. The day of installation was as promised, installers were wonderful, arrived on time, reviewed the project, how each stage would progress etc. Vern and Mike involved us each step of the way. So pleased with our new walk in shower. Highly recommend Zintex.
Great work, completed quickly and accurately, and very clean!

We had the tub/shower replaced with a walking shower by Zintex.  It looks great and we are very happy with the results. The project team (Timi/Rebecca/Scott) and the installer, (Denzil) were amazing. We appreciate their expertise and professionism.
Salesman (Brad) was very friendly and informative. Knew his “stuff”. Installer (Jason) was also very personable and worked hard to get everything done correctly.

From start to finish my experience with Zintex’s Staff and Installation Team was perfection!  Each team member explained in detail the process and made sure I fully understood all that would happen. I will recommend Zintex to all my friends and family.
Very professional and using utmost care to keep walk ways clean.
The installers were prompt and courteous. Cleaned up and removed all old and excess materials.  Emily was very helpful and answered all my questions.

Rigo Rosas, the installer, did a fantastic job installing our new shower.  We couldn’t be more pleased with the outcome! Timi Abney was the representative who first came to our house, measured the bathroom and guided us through the order and what to expect.  She did a great job.
The installation guys showed up bright and early and got busy. They worked diligently until late into the evening so they could finish the job. I very pleased with their results!
I'm  so excited about our new walk in shower.  It is awesome it looks really good.

I had Zintex put in a new shower after my wife 2 strokes back in November 2025. The install team was amazing as well as all the chain of command. I personally recommend Zintex and especially for  their fast,professional removal and install of new shower. They were super clean and respectful.  I appreciate their personal caring attitude for my wife needs. Ms Mirella was noteworthy for being a crucial in the process and a big special thank you! I love that the company stands by their lifetime warranty as they responded in 1day for a toilet issue we had just before the 4th of July, while they are not the cheapest option they certainly are the best! As a retired Navy Senior Chief I can agree
you get what you pay for and that's a quality they back up with superior products and workmanship,  coupled with a lifetime warranty and that means the world to me.Thank you Mirella and Zintex.
Install went great. Love my new walk in shower. Rebecca was a great help too.
Very professional Josiah was wonderful and Kate was helpful throughout the process I loved working with them and will let all my friends know how happy we are. Thank you Josiah and Kate

Jonathan Lancaster was our consultant…such a nice man. He explained the entire process extremely well and thoroughly. The entire process of his visit was seamless and he clearly is well knowledgeable about the company and services he’s providing. He’s got the best personality…I really enjoyed his visit.

My journey was amazing. It started with research and great advertisement. Cindy Holt reached out and scheduled my Consultation appointment. The guy that came out to do my appointment was very nice and understanding of my desires. We
mapped out the designs and costs and then Cindy helped me download the app where I was able to track every step of my progress while she also checked in periodically. Matt Chisholm was my installer. He was very nice and communicated with me step-by-step through the process. He went above and beyond and was very understanding of my schedule and family needs. I love my installations.  I got two; a tub replaced as a walk-in shower and a new Jacuzzi tub replacing an old one.  I’m very happy with them and I would recommend this company.  THANKYOU so much.

Brian, Brandon & Carmus, installed the walk-shower. They did everything that was on the work order and more, to make everything fit as it should. The day the walls were up, Brian explained to me, where the grab poles would be put, and I had him charge the height to better fit my range of grip. After the shower was finished, Brian showed me the 2 shower heads & how they worked. Before his crew left, he vacuum the floors & made sure that everything they brought into the house and out in the yard was picked up and taken with them.

Zintex remodeling  took out my bathtub and replaced with a shower. Nicholas  and Matt  did a wonderful job.they left everything  clean and neat also.  Ms Emily  did great keeping  me informed  and making sure the work was going good.  I would  recommend  zintex

Installion was complete in 1 day.
Very professional and clean

Every aspect of our experience wth Zintex was fabulous!  Our salesman, Seth, our guy who scheduled everything, Alex, and the three guys who installed all my windows were absolutely wonderful. I could not be happier with my new beautiful windows and all my dealings with Xintex.
Highly recommend. Bobby and Tiffany did a quality installation.
Installation was fast. completed in a day and the installer Bryan did such a great job and was friendly.
The whole experience has been amazing! Everyone has been extremely friendly and helpful! Our new shower is amazing and I can’t wait to use it!
The process was great, they did exactly what they said and in the time alotted. Chris the installer did a great job and left everything clean.

The entire process of getting a walk in shower for my parents was so streamlined, from beginning to end. We were made aware of every step by Cindy. Zach, our installer, was amazing. I still don’t know how he was able to do it all by himself. The removal was no interruption to our day and the clean up was awesome. It was like nothing was ever there until he completed the install. Both Cindy and Zach were very friendly and professional. Definitely recommend!!!
Installer Austin did an amazing job. Major prob for cleaning up behind themselves.  Bathroom looks bad ass lol
Thorough and knowledgeable and worked hard to get the best price!

Ryan, our Tech man and
Scott, our Project Manager
are both very knowledgeable, professional and kind. We added things in addition to our initial installation. Scott arranged the appointment. Ryan came to install the products.
I would highly recommend Zintex for a shower remodel.
Seth was amazing and took the time to show us how everything worked. Will definitely be using again when time to update master shower.

Zintex did a great job installing my tub to shower conversion. It was completed on time.  Jennifer, came to the house and looked over the bathroom. Then set up the appointment. Joe, my installer did a excellent job. Chelsea, my contact kept me informed of when the installation would take place and it all went down like clockwork.
Jacuzzi is fortunate to have Zintex and the folks that work with them installing the product.
I am very pleased with the results.
Our new Zintex shower is awesome! Marco and Dominic were two of the best craftsman that I have ever observed!

Love our new walk in Shower. Juan and Emily are the greatest. Juan made sure we understood every part of the installation.
Thank you Juan, Emily, Zintex
Got t a quote that turn our Bathtub into a shower. Price seems reasonable. Asante was very nice and knowledgeable.

We. absolutely love our new Jacuzzi shower by Zintex. Our installer, Jonathan Landeche, was very professional and did a great job. He made sure it was exactly what we wanted. The account manager, Cindy Holt, made sure it was scheduled at a convenient time for us. It was a breeze working with both of them. Highly recommend Zintex Remodeling Group.

A knowledgeable representative Greg came out to the house and we could design the walk-in shower for my husband. Emily worked great Scheduling And answering questions. Martin helped quite a bit when some work that needed to be tended to after the installation. I’m very happy with the beauty of the shower and feel it will work well for my husband who has Parkinson’s

This job was efficient and the end result was AWESOME.  Did not know it would look so good. Can hardly wait to use it. Have to wait another 24 hours for all to set in place. Workers were kind and were about the business of finishing the project.  Thank you, great job.

I had a entire shower put in to replace tub do to age and inability to climb in and out of tub, they came in and did the job in one day, very clean respectful and I was so happy, I went to shower and had no water pressure, I thought I was doing something wrong so I waited until my daughter came up to check but it was not me so I called the company and they were out within a hour and fixed the problem and I was good to go!! Wonderful fast service!!

Zintex was so speedy when I called with my problems, they came out with in a hour and fixed the problem and was very responsive and helpful! I was and am very happy with the response I received! Great service 🤗🤗🤗
Cindy was fantastic on her presentation and knowledge of her product.  She made us feel very comfortable.

We replaced all of our windows in our 2 story home. Prior to we could hear everything outside and some rooms were warmer than others. The difference is incredible! Quieter and heat efficient. The sales team, the window installers, and project manager are amazing. They went above and beyond to make sure we had the best windows for our needs.
From start to finish was one one the best. All were friendly and professional .

Hello Zintex,
From the time,  Brandi Perkins, came into our home, showed us the possibilities of a bathtub/shower removal to the safety of a walk-in shower we were ready for the make-over. So thankful she gave us the overall “picture” of what to expect. She is a great introduction to your company.

Christian Garcia and brother Ervin were our installers. Very polite, quick to answer our questions, and protective of our home, insured our experience with their install. We now have a beautiful new Walk in Shower that we are so proud of. They did a fantastic install with grab bars and a seat for added comfort.
Thank you Zintex for your professionalism!
Wayne and Norma Hellman. June 2026.
Nick Alon worked very head and great with details.
Was on time, nice, and understanding.
Jared was beyond professional and his work is impeccable! Highly recommend him!

Josh at Zintex Nashville was incredible in our meeting. He worked with us to find the bath we liked and did everything he could to make it work within our budget. Would recommend meeting with him 10/10 times!

Logan Rust sold us the job and David Elms was the installer. He did a great job and left the house clean. We are adding a steamer to the shower so had to get special door so will take 3 weeks. But I bought a cheap shower curtain for now. I will add pics when glass door gets installed
Dakota and Callie our installers did a great job and also Rebecca did a good job

Jacuzzi Remodel Means Zintex (in many states). In our state that means that you deal exclusively with Zintex. Our Jacuzzi shower installation began on 03/17/2025 and continued through 04/18/2025. There are some very nice people working at Zintex. From my experience with our Jacuzzi shower install ($18,614.00) many of these nice people seem to be overwhelmed with carrying out their responsibilities. I expected with such an expensive project that the installers would conduct the installation in a precise and exacting manner. They did not! Instead it was as if the installers had never done a Jacuzzi shower install before based on the numerous mistakes that were made. The two installers (both nice people) were in our house for over 12 hours. They said they would have finished except they had stripped the paint off the nut on the handheld hose because of a faulty washer and would have to bring the replacement part the next day. There was no walk through final inspection because if there had been they may have realized that they had made numerous errors: 1) the Teak Wood Seat was so badly mounted that the back of the seat could not be attached properly to the wall; 2) the Handrail was not level and looked obviously crooked; 3) the two Corner Shelves were obviously crooked; 4) the Exterior Caulking around the base was sloppily done; 5) the existing Quarter Round Molding (2 1/2") was removed from the left side at the base and not put back in place. On the right side this molding was removed and put back in a sloppy fashion; 6) the Bottom of the Door Frame was mounted in reverse fashion so that water leaked freely onto the outside floor when the shower was used. Even after this was corrected the door leaked excessively (Bad Design?). Another attempt to fix this was made 31 days later by adding a plastic/silicone snap on piece to the bottom of the door. It fell off 4 days later and I will try super glue to keep it on; 7) the Floor Made substantial Noise and was Very Bouncy; 8) the Shower Walls are not flush with the existing sheet rock walls; 9) the Diverter assembly did not line up with the shower head pipe coming out of the wall at the top and the On/Off assembly at the bottom. The Diverter was 1/4" off center; 10) the On/Off lever when turned completely to Off position is not vertical; 11) the Handle on the Shower Door was Crooked/Not Vertical - it was off by 1/8". It took the field manager (Genaro V.) two visits over the period of a month to correct/fix/re-do all but two of the problems which are not in a practical sense able to be fixed (walls not flush with existing sheet rock and On/Off lever not vertical when turned completely off). Genaro was Excellent! It was a very stressful month not knowing what could and what could not be fixed. My point is that even if everything could have been fixed the next day, this disastrous installation should never have occurred in the first place with such an expensive product. I requested a partial refund from Zintex and my request was initially ignored and then, finally, denied. All of the above makes Zintex look like a somewhat dysfunctional company. So, if you're getting a Jacuzzi remodel done by Zintex, all I can say is: Buyer Beware!

Thankfully the field manager Scott Perry showed up within a day or two and got the design and needs correct. I don’t like signing 10-year contracts on a phone screen and there were few options offered. Scott got it right.

Our “project manager” Kiyanne gave enough information and let us know the material ordering was on track and when to expect the installer. I don’t understand how a large company doesn’t have a nearly pre-generated handout to send out with that information, including what you should have and how to prepare the bathroom. Although we did empty the bathroom, buy some new items for it and prepare an old popcorn ceiling, no one really said much about how to get ready. Scott did mention the installer would texture the walls but not paint, but these things could easily surprise a customer. When the Zintex work is done, you will still need to prime and paint and possibly install things like towel-rings or cabinets other than the vanity.Enough for the half-star.

The installer, Matt Zachar was amazing. We’ve dealt with several contractors, installers, and construction companies over the last few years (bought a 50-year old house) and no one has been as professional, skilled, and courteous as Matt. He showed up on time, communicated well about arrivals and departures, and took great care of our house, laying drop cloths everywhere he walked or worked, and was always business-like but pleasant. The quality of his work was excellent and he worked quietly without bashing walls or breaking things. He identified and then fixed several wicked problems from the past. In the end we were thrilled with the work and product. Zintex contracted out the electrical work and Matt made sure our light was centered and the guy didn’t damage anything.  As an aside, he had the best organized work and tool trailer I’ve ever seen and should be sponsored by the Milwaukee tool company. He’s a living advertisement for them as well as a shiny recommendation for Zintex.

In the end, we are very happy with a beautiful shower and great bathroom and should we need the next one, will unreservedly call on Zintex again.
